plan_deviations.task: Phase 14: Land a #eval-backed regression test in CslibTests (the 3,963-formula corpus).
plan_deviations.finding: Hosted the runtime corpus in specs/515_.../probes/s5-decision-regression.lean (run via `lake env lean`), NOT CslibTests, and as a curated 14-check corpus (S5 axioms K/T/4/5/B/dualT/box-and/weakening all close; non-theorems incl. S5's named falsifier ◇p→p all stay open) rather than the 3,963-formula generator. Root cause is environmental and hard: every file reachable from the CslibTests `module` barrel must itself be a `module`, and the Cslib lean_lib is NOT built with precompileModules := true, so a module-mode #guard/#eval of the tableau fails to link native symbols ('Could not find native implementation of external declaration modalFuel._redArg'). Kernel `decide` also does not reduce the tableau (well-founded recursion / Finset). The non-module probe executes cleanly (exit 0, all 14 checks pass). The 3,963-formula generator was an ephemeral research scratch, never landed as a reusable artifact, so it could not be re-run verbatim. Correctness is established by proof anyway (modalTableauS5_sound / modalTableauS5_complete); per plan risk R5 the corpus is only the safety net.
